text:
Bright hello floor staff,
Tiring phase so far, and the shift lead discussed a point about lounge space

Thanks for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm and steady through the busy flow. Please keep greeting travelers with a soft voice, confirm pet tags early, and route any nervous families to the quiet corner before boarding builds up. Safety still comes before speed on every journey, and that steady pace helps everyone feel looked after.

For the lounge notes, keep an eye on crates, water bowls, and cleanup supplies so the space stays ready for the next arrival. When a case needs extra attention, pass it along through the usual calm review path and keep the handoff simple. I also want everyone to stay kind with one another if the desk gets crowded; a little patience goes a long way.

If Ines Hassan or Isaac Davis comes through with Rosie, please give them the same warm, careful service we expect for every pet traveler. Keep listening closely, share updates early, and let the team know before a small issue becomes a larger one. Thanks for the care you bring every shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
